title: The book of one syllable

description: "The Book of One Syllable" by Esther Bakewell is a collection of short stories written during the late 19th century. Designed to be accessible to young readers, the book employs simple language, utilizing only one-syllable words to convey moral lessons through various tales that explore themes such as honesty, self-restraint, and the consequences of one's actions.
